# Community Pull Request Template for Zenith DAW

## 🌟 Thank You for Contributing!

Welcome! We're thrilled you want to contribute to the Zenith DAW community. This template helps us review your contribution quickly and effectively.

## Description
Please provide a clear and concise description of what this pull request accomplishes. What problem does it solve or what feature does it add?

### Type of Contribution
Please mark the appropriate type(s):
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update (adds or improves documentation)
- [ ] Community enhancement (templates, examples, tutorials)
- [ ] Translation/localization
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement

## Checklist
Please ensure you have completed the following steps:

### Code Quality
- [ ] My code follows the [Zenith DAW Coding Style Guide](https://github.com/your-repo/zenith-daw/blob/main/docs/DEVELOPER.md)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings or errors
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] All existing tests still pass

### Documentation
- [ ] I have updated the documentation accordingly (if applicable)
- [ ] I have added or updated comments for new functions/classes
- [ ] README.md has been updated (if applicable)
- [ ] If this is a community contribution, I've included usage examples

### Change Impact
- [ ] I have considered the impact on performance
- [ ] I have considered the impact on memory usage
- [ ] I have considered the impact on thread safety
- [ ] I have tested this change on the target platforms:
  - [ ] Windows
  - [ ] macOS
  - [ ] Linux

### Community Guidelines
- [ ] I have read and understood the [Community Guidelines](https://github.com/your-repo/zenith-daw/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [ ] I understand that this PR may be closed if it doesn't follow the guidelines
- [ ] I will be responsive to feedback and comments during the review process
